meta.note: Dates curated from organizer listings. ALWAYS confirm on the organizer's page before travelling.

events.name: Acronis x ICS: Business IT Security — Free Breakfast & Learn
events.description: Free breakfast seminar on business IT security — backup, ransomware defense and cyber hygiene for small-to-medium businesses, hosted by local MSP Interactive Computer Systems with Acronis.
events.directions: Downtown Fredericton, Queen Street. On-street metered parking nearby and the Kings Place parkade (17 King St) is a 3-min walk. Follow the Trans-Canada Hwy/Route 8 to the Queen St exit; the building is between York and Regent streets on the north side.
events.registrationNote: Sign up through the event listing — free, but seats are limited.

events.name: ITIL 5 Foundation Certification Training
events.description: Two-day instructor-led ITIL 5 Foundation certification course for IT service management professionals. Exam voucher typically included.
events.directions: Same building as the ICS event — 320 Queen St, downtown. Metered street parking plus Kings Place parkade (17 King St) across the block. City buses 10/11/20/21 stop on Queen St.
events.registrationNote: Paid registration — Purchase a seat with the training provider (≈ USD 1,500); exam voucher typically included.

events.name: Planet Hatch Office Hours
events.address: 50 Crowther Lane, Suite 140, Fredericton, NB E3C 0J1
events.description: Recurring monthly drop-in office hours with startup mentors at Knowledge Park's innovation hub. Bring your idea, prototype or pitch deck.
events.directions: Knowledge Park on Fredericton's north side: from the Westmorland Street Bridge follow Ring Road / Two Nations Crossing; exit at Crowther Lane. Free visitor parking in front of the Salesforce Building. Bus route 30 stops nearby.
events.registrationNote: No registration — just drop in during office hours. Free.

events.name: EMP — Exploration, Mining & Petroleum NB Conference
events.organizer: New Brunswick Dept. of Natural Resources (industry partners)
events.description: Atlantic Canada's exploration, mining and petroleum conference — geoscience, drilling tech, AI in resource exploration, and industry networking.
events.directions: On Woodstock Road (Route 2/8 corridor) just west of downtown. Free hotel parking; 10 min walk to the Beaverbrook area. From downtown: follow Queen St west, cross the Gibson Bridge.
events.registrationNote: Paid registration — Conference registration via the organizer; passes sell out ahead of the event.

events.name: Business Basics — Ignite Fredericton
events.address: 50 Crowther Lane, Suite 140, Fredericton, NB E3C 0J1
events.description: Bi-weekly info session covering the foundational steps of starting a business — structure, funding, registration — led by Ignite's startup advisors.
events.directions: Same Knowledge Park location as Planet Hatch Office Hours (see that listing). Free visitor parking; 15 min drive from downtown across the Westmorland St. Bridge.
events.registrationNote: Free session — registering on the Ignite calendar helps organizers plan, but walk-ins are usually welcome.

events.name: Africa Diaspora Entrepreneurs Forum 2026: Canada
events.organizer: Africa Diaspora Entrepreneurs Forum / local partners
events.description: Multi-day forum connecting diaspora entrepreneurs with capital, mentors and Atlantic Canadian tech/innovation ecosystem players. Panels, pitch sessions and B2B matchmaking.
events.directions: Heart of downtown, beside City Hall and the Playhouse. Paid indoor parking at the Convention Centre (entrance off St. John St); also Kings Place parkade and street meters. Convention Centre is a 2-min walk from the officers' square transit hub.
events.registrationNote: Tickets via the event page (≈ USD 105).

events.name: Fredericton Makerspace — Open Nights, Maker Talks & Workshops
events.description: Community workshop for 3D printing, electronics, woodworking and more. Open nights, Maker Talks fundraisers and hands-on workshops run year-round — next date is posted on their site (often monthly).
events.directions: North side of the city, on Canada Street (off the Ring Road / Two Nations Crossing area). Street parking available; bus routes 20/21/24 pass nearby. If you're new, a member can tour you around at the start of any event.
events.registrationNote: Open nights and Maker Talks are free walk-ins; some hands-on workshops ask for a small donation and a spot can be booked on their site.

events.name: UNB Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity — Public Seminar Series
events.venue: UNB Fredericton Campus — Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity
events.description: Recurring public seminars on cyber operations, threat research and AI security, often featuring visiting researchers and industry speakers. Dates posted term-by-term on the CIC site.
events.directions: On UNB's Fredericton campus, near the Aikenhead Centre. Free visitor parking in the Windsor St lots after 5 PM; campus is a 10-min walk from downtown across the Saint John River.
events.registrationNote: Open to the public and free — no registration needed; check the CIC site for the term schedule.

events.name: UNB Computer Science Colloquium Series
events.venue: Gillin Hall — UNB Faculty of Computer Science
events.description: Weekly colloquium series during the fall & winter terms (Sep–Dec, Jan–Apr): visiting researchers and faculty talk AI, machine learning, systems, HCI and more. Free and open to the public — schedule is posted at the start of each term.
events.directions: Gillin Hall on the UNB campus, off Bailey Drive. Visitor parking in the lots off Bailey Dr after 5 PM; campus is a 10-min walk from downtown across the Saint John River footbridge.
events.registrationNote: Free and open to the public — just walk in. Schedule posts at the start of each term.

events.name: UNB Engineering & Computer Science Design Showcase
events.organizer: UNB Faculty of Engineering & Computer Science
events.description: Annual spring showcase (typically April) where final-year engineering and computer science students demo their capstone projects — robotics, apps, hardware and research prototypes. Great place to spot future hires.
events.directions: Wu Conference Centre on the UNB campus (6 Duffie Drive). Paid parking at the centre; bus routes 20/21/22 stop at the campus gates.
events.registrationNote: Free public showcase — no registration to attend.

events.name: BMO Apex Startup Challenge
events.venue: Wu Conference Centre, UNB + Planet Hatch
events.address: 6 Duffie Drive + 50 Crowther Lane, Fredericton, NB
events.description: Atlantic Canada's biggest student startup competition — $30,000+ in prizes. Teams pitch live; the 2026 edition ran Jan 22–23 (elevator pitch night at Planet Hatch, finals & awards at the Wu Conference Centre). Next edition expected late January 2027 — watch the IBEC page.
events.directions: Finals at the Wu Conference Centre (6 Duffie Dr, UNB campus); the Thursday elevator-pitch night is at Planet Hatch (50 Crowther Ln, Knowledge Park). Free parking at both after hours.
events.registrationNote: Free to attend as audience; competing teams register through IBEC in the fall.

events.name: NBIF Breakthru Live Finale
events.description: The finale of NBIF's flagship startup program — the finalist companies pitch live for a share of the multi-million-dollar Breakthru investment pool. 2026 edition was March 19 at the Convention Centre; next edition expected mid-March 2027.
events.directions: Fredericton Convention Centre, 670 Queen St downtown — indoor paid parking off St. John St; 2-min walk from the transit hub at Officers' Square.
events.registrationNote: Free to attend — no registration required.

events.name: MERGE Demo Day — Planet Hatch
events.address: 50 Crowther Lane, Suite 140, Fredericton, NB E3C 0J1
events.description: Demo day for Planet Hatch's startup–municipality program: startups show the real-world solutions they built in partnership with Capital Region municipalities. 2026 edition ran March 24 — next cohort demo typically spring 2027.
events.directions: Planet Hatch, 50 Crowther Lane (Salesforce Building), Knowledge Park — free visitor parking; 15 min from downtown via the Westmorland St. Bridge.
events.registrationNote: Free demo day — just show up.

events.name: BBI Networking Night at Planet Hatch
events.address: 50 Crowther Lane, Suite 140, Fredericton, NB E3C 0J1
events.description: Monthly-ish evening networking at Planet Hatch, run in partnership with Futurpreneurs — founders, funders and the curious, with food and drinks. Typically 5:30–8 PM.
events.directions: Planet Hatch, 50 Crowther Lane (Salesforce Building), Knowledge Park — free visitor parking; 15 min from downtown via the Westmorland St. Bridge.
events.registrationNote: Free networking night — RSVPing through the Ignite calendar helps the hosts, but drop-ins are welcome.

events.name: Fredericton Public Library — Tech & Maker Workshops
events.description: Ongoing tech programming for all ages — coding clubs, robotics, 3D printing demos, maker kits and digital-skills workshops. Most programs are free; the calendar is posted seasonally.
events.directions: Downtown next to City Hall, across from the Convention Centre. Free City Hall lot parking after 6 PM; 1-min walk from the Officers' Square transit hub.
events.registrationNote: Most programs are free; some workshops need a spot booked through the library calendar.

events.name: Science East — STEM Maker Labs & Workshops
events.description: Interactive science centre in the historic York County Jail building — hands-on STEM workshops, maker labs, robotics days and school-break tech camps.
events.directions: 668 Brunswick St, downtown. Street parking plus the nearby Carleton St parkade; 5-min walk from Officers' Square.
events.registrationNote: Pay admission at the door; hands-on workshops and camps often need advance booking.

events.name: Women in Tech NB — Networking & Talks
events.address: Fredericton, NB (venue varies — see organizer listing)
events.organizer: Women in Tech New Brunswick (WiT NB)
events.description: Community network for women and allies in New Brunswick tech — fireside chats with local leaders, skill-building sessions and relaxed networking. Events rotate venues around the province; Fredericton editions happen regularly.
events.directions: Venue rotates between Planet Hatch, UNB and downtown Fredericton — check the organizer's listing for each event.
events.registrationNote: Usually free — registration is on each event listing.

events.name: NBCC Fredericton — Tech Program Info Sessions
events.description: Free info sessions on NBCC's technology programs — IT Support & Network Security, Software Development, Cybersecurity and more — with campus tours and program instructors on hand. Offered throughout the year, heaviest in fall.
events.directions: NBCC Fredericton Campus at 26 Duffie Drive, on the hill above downtown — free visitor parking; bus routes 20/21/22 stop nearby.
events.registrationNote: Free info sessions — registering ahead helps NBCC plan seating.
